summary: GeneralPurposeEstimate::new rounds up by adding 7 for chunk counts and 3 for decoded-length estimates before division. These additions overflow near usize::MAX, causing a panic instead of returning an estimate. The fix divides first and adds a remainder indicator, preserving rounding without overflow. The test added by the fix checks both ends of the usize range against u128 calculations; reversing the constructor should first panic at usize::MAX - 6 during chunk-count calculation. This is a source-based plan; no tests were run.
expected_failure: Overflow when calculating number of chunks in input
